semiconductor_relevance: High — Ikeda Metal Industrial supplies essential components like wire inserts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, reinforcing female threads in materials used in the industry.
summary: Ikeda Metal Industrial is a key distributor in Japan for semiconductor equipment components, specializing in products that reinforce female threads in aluminum and resin. They offer a comprehensive service from custom part manufacturing to quality control, ensuring high standards for semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Distribution of Recoil wire inserts for thread reinforcement
Mass production of screws made from titanium and titanium alloys
Custom parts manufacturing and surface treatment
Quality control with over 10,000 acceptance inspections annually

regional_presence.Japan: Ikeda Metal Industrial serves as the sole distributor for Recoil products in Japan, catering to local semiconductor manufacturing needs.
